title: Kashmir Scenic Retreat Group Departure
shortDescription: This thoughtfully planned journey offers a well rounded introduction to Kashmir, blending scenic beauty, cultural landmarks, and relaxed sightseeing.
description: This thoughtfully planned journey offers a well rounded introduction to Kashmir, blending scenic beauty, cultural landmarks, and relaxed sightseeing. From tranquil moments on Dal Lake and garden walks in Srinagar to the alpine meadows of Sonmarg and Gulmarg, the itinerary balances iconic experiences with comfortable pacing.

The route continues through river valleys and countryside landscapes to Pahalgam, allowing time to unwind amidst nature. With guided excursions, smooth transfers, and a memorable houseboat stay, this tour is ideal for travellers seeking a scenic and unhurried exploration of Kashmir’s most loved highlights.

highlights: Mughal Gardens and a houseboat stay

itinerary.title: Arrive Srinagar
itinerary.description: Arrive at Srinagar Airport and transfer to the hotel. Check in and settle into your stay. Enjoy a one-hour shikara ride on Dal Lake at Nehru Park. Visit a local handicrafts showroom showcasing carpets, shawls, and jewellery.

itinerary.title: Sonmarg Day Excursion
itinerary.description: Drive back to Srinagar by evening. View Thajiwas Glacier with optional pony hire. Travel to Sonmarg on a full-day excursion from Srinagar. Explore the Sonmarg valley known as the Meadow of Gold.

itinerary.title: Gulmarg Mountain Escape
itinerary.description: Drive from Srinagar to Gulmarg after breakfast. Take in views of the surrounding mountains and landscapes. Opt for a short trek to Khilanmarg or a Gondola ride to Kongdoori (on direct payment basis).

itinerary.title: Gulmarg – Pahalgam
itinerary.description: Depart Gulmarg for Pahalgam after breakfast. Drive via Pampore, Avantipura, and Bijbehara village. Pass through Anantnag while following the Lidder River route. Check in at the hotel and enjoy leisure time.

itinerary.title: Mughal Gardens and Houseboat
itinerary.description: Drive from Pahalgam to Srinagar after breakfast. Visit Chashme Shahi, Shalimar Garden, and Nishat Garden. Stop at Shankaracharya Temple. Transfer to a houseboat in the evening.

itinerary.title: Departure from Srinagar
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and morning time at leisure. Transfer to Srinagar Airport for onward journey.
